description:
• Brand introduction: 

IF Supplements is a York-based sports supplement company committed to providing premium, science-backed products that support athletes and fitness enthusiasts in achieving their performance and wellness goals. Founded by personal trainer Marius Matulevicius, IF Supplements reflects a deep-rooted passion for fitness and nutrition, offering a range of carefully formulated products to help fuel athletic progress, enhance recovery, and elevate overall health. 


• Product description:

Our product line includes high-quality protein powders, pre-workouts, and recovery supplements, each crafted with high-grade ingredients and backed by scientific research. Every supplement is designed with active individuals in mind, catering to a variety of fitness needs, from muscle building and endurance support to energy boosts and post-workout recovery. Each product is crafted to maximize efficacy while ensuring safety and transparency.  


• USP (Unique Selling Point):

IF Supplements stands out with its commitment to quality and transparency. Every product is rigorously tested to ensure it meets high standards, providing only what’s necessary for optimal performance with no fillers or unnecessary additives. Our dedication to quality, combined with our direct insight into the fitness community, enables us to offer tailored, effective products that genuinely work.  


• Payment terms:

We offer a competitive commission rate on all referred sales. Affiliates will receive monthly payouts, with flexible payment options to suit individual needs. Payment terms can be discussed further, ensuring a rewarding collaboration for our partners.

 
• Other information:

As an affiliate, you’ll benefit from exclusive insights into product launches, seasonal promotions, and ongoing marketing support. Additionally, we’ll provide you with professionally crafted content and unique discount codes to enhance your referrals and help you make the most of each opportunity. Join the IF Supplements affiliate program and grow with us as we help people across the UK unlock their fitness potential.
